title: Persistent Chiral Excitation Pinning and Distributed Reservoir Confinement on IBM Heron Processors
description: Preregistered hardware experimental data across 9 phases (1011 physical circuits) verifying chiral current inversion, non-equilibrium excitation pinning (Z = 13.63), and distributed reservoir decoupling on IBM Heron r2 superconducting processors (ibm_marrakesh and ibm_kingston).
